purpose: Post-hoc provenance repair for the S10-B1 source extractions. The published source-manifest.json files for lichess-standard-rated-v2/v3/v4 were produced by tools/s6/lichess_select.py at a revision that hardcoded the manifest filters block (mainline_plies_min=40, long_stratum_plies_min=80, long_fraction=1/3) and the selection text (first byte < 0x05) regardless of the actual command-line arguments used. The actual extraction command lines were not preserved in any retrievable execution log, so the effective min_plies / long_min_plies / long_fraction / accept_byte arguments are recorded here as PARTIAL provenance rather than guessed. The immutable PGN SHA-256s remain the authoritative source identities. The 300k dataset s10-eval-v1-300k01 (dataset SHA 503b47b6a6fb33f3248e0f15d69de67fcd4334bdefce174767b720910a9076b3) is FROZEN and was NOT rebuilt or re-derived as part of this repair.

repair_commit_context.manifest_serialization_fix: tools/s6/lichess_select.py now records args.min_plies, args.long_min_plies, args.long_fraction, and args.accept_byte in the filters block and formats the actual accept-byte threshold into the selection text; targeted tests assert non-default arguments round-trip exactly (tools/s6/test_lichess_select.py ManifestEffectiveArgumentsTests).
